correctness.rationale: The signed 15–48–30 cubical complex is constructed from the complete 6-vertex octahedral graph. Exact chain-boundary verification gives ranks 14 and 26; the Smith normal form has exactly 26 unit invariants. Four explicit opposite-face product tori form a primitive rank-four lattice (a 4x4 determinant is +1), hence the full top homology. Exact full enumeration checks all 48 automorphism chain maps and the oriented torus permutation formula. Signed cellular Lefschetz traces and irreducible character inner products give precisely the claimed first/second rational modules. The Prue–Scrimshaw theorem verifies equivalence of model and continuous configuration space; no infinite-family generalization is inferred.

value.rationale: The octahedron is a canonical nontrivial 3-connected planar graph with full order-48 polyhedral symmetry. The exact classification yields a complete physically interpretable positive-degree symmetry module: a natural four-torus integral basis with sign/determinant orientation and four distinct first-homology rational irreducibles. This is not determined by its Betti vector or the broad existence of disjoint-cycle tori, and it forms a reference instance for equivariant graph-braid topology. It does not assert an integral first-homology lattice or a family theorem.
